digest.component_or_area: maintenance audit runbook and project adapter
propositions: The maintenance audit runbook should be rewritten as a rebar-project adapter delegating audit phases to the packaged janitor skill workflow.
The module limit must be documented as an absolute CI gate sourced from .github/module-size-limit.txt instead of described as a soft cap.
Dated machine state, measurements, findings, and capture debris should be removed from the maintained procedure; historical context should reference tickets instead.
Project-specific gate commands and their inputs must remain executable and documented in the refactored runbook.
Session logs and tickets are required as durable artifacts for progress tracking and decisions in this repository.
All documented read-only commands and documentation link checks must pass verification.
